description: This file defines the AWS Route53RecoveryReadinessClient class, which extends the AwsClient class and provides methods for interacting with the AWS Route53 Recovery Readiness service. It includes PHPDoc annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, retrieving, and updating recovery readiness resources.
